resources.string: Capture four fresh, unmirrored camera images without overlays. Saves PNGs, full UYVY frames, field/timing metadata and readable vehicle calibration under camera-snapshots in the selected recording folder. Cameras must be available to this app; recording stays unchanged.

Saved all four cameras:
%1$s

Includes left/right/front/rear PNG + raw UYVY and manifest.json. PNGs spatially weave the fields; moving objects may show interlace artifacts. The raw frames allow other deinterlacing locally.
